Power

Equipment:Turning Gear
Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspections I1, which must 
be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in above title block.
The device used for slowly motion speed: 
1/8 revolution per 3 minute. The ratchet turning gears is used for turning the 
turbine rotor after shutdown and reach its speed to zero.
Technical 
specification

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mahmoud Abu El-Fetouh Shata, 
tested by eng. Abed Esmaiel Mohamed, accepted by eng. 
Yousry Abdel-Maqsoud: general director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality 
control's general director, and approved by eng.
Fathy Mahmod Ragap 
head sector of Talkha Power Station.
This document is accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
planning 
and financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance stuff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as
 safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor (turning gear motor).
Disconnect electric terminals of the turning gear 
 motor.
Isolate the turning gear mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Ensure pumps must be completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Vibrometer
Rags
Work to be Carried Out
Check and record the discharge quantity & pressure of ratchet turning gear 
 pump
Check and record
 the vibration level for ratchet turning 
 gear
Check and adjust clearance between mating 
 gears not exceed 0.25 mm)
Check bearing clearance (0.0015 x shaft 
 diameter)
During 
Operation
Check the vibration level for ratchet turning gear.
Check the lube oil pressure and level of oil 
 tank
